comment: Every manifest feature in one place; copy from it. A folder whose name starts with an underscore is an
example: --all skips it and it is baked only with --out, so nothing lands in the mod:

sprites.name: svg_ring
sprites.html: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='30' height='30'><defs><linearGradient id='demo-ring' x1='0' x2='1'><stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff'/><stop offset='1' stop-color='#fff' stop-opacity='.15'/></linearGradient></defs><circle cx='15' cy='15' r='12' fill='none' stroke='url(#demo-ring)' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

textures.name: frame
textures.html: 200 x 100 units, no size: the content is the top-left 300x150 px of a 512x256 canvas

textures.name: window
textures.html: 300 x 170 units stretched over the whole 512x256 canvas
